scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run audit:permissions && npm test
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run test:browser && npm run test:peek && npm run build:firefox && node peek/scripts/build-firefox.mjs
scripts.package: rm -f keybit.zip && zip -qr keybit.zip manifest.json icons src -x '*.DS_Store' && echo 'Created keybit.zip'
scripts.pack:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist/firefox && zip -qr ../keybit.xpi . && echo 'Created dist/keybit.xpi'
